posts.author: Galv
posts.body:
Fishing Mini Game - Version 1.7
RPG Maker MV Plugin
Galv
​
Introduction
My Breath of Fire 2 inspired mini game now has an MV version. This is not a plug-and-play plugin and requires a lot of setup!
Screenshot
Features
This plugin adds a new fishing mini game to your project similar to that of Breath of Fire 2’s. This plugin is not plug-and-play and requires setting up. It may be difficult for new users.
– Customise a range of fish attributes to change how they behave such as bait they eat, speed, difficulty to reel in (and more)
– Customise each fishing spot’s backgrounds and music
– Add specific fish or objects or randomize them for each fishing spot. Use eventing to add quest items to catch from the water.
The demo contains examples of some things you can do.
You’ll notice that the RTP doesn’t come with many useful fishing icons (to use for rods and baits), and there’s not a whole lot of fish for you to use included in the demo – you’ll need to source or make your own resources to use.
How to Use
- Copy the "GALV_Fishing.js" file into your project's /js/plugins/ folder.
- Activate plugin using the 'Plugin Manager'
- Create a new folder: /img/fishing/ and copy images from the demo to use as templates
- Read the help file and examine the demo to learn how it works
Plugin
Get it here
Credit and Thanks
- Galv
- Matt Beer for the fish
Terms
May be used in free projects but please PM me if you wish to use this in a commercial project.
Updates
2020-09-07 - Version 1.7 - fixed reeling SE issue and added option to lose bait on successful catch
2017-06-24 - Version 1.6 - fixed Confirm button not skipping fish caught info window
2017-04-01 - Version 1.5 - fixed click/touch for reeling/cancelling/etc
2017-03-09 - Version 1.4 - added click/touch for casting the line
2016-12-25 - Version 1.3 - fixed a bug where item wouldn't be gained with a custom message. Fixed a bug where static "fish" (eg. chest) wouldn't sink to the bottom if pulled up and line breaks
2016-11-21 - Version 1.2 - fixed a bug when fishing from a vehicle
2016-11-12 - Version 1.1 - fixed a bug that the fish item wasn't actually obtained when catching the fish.
2016-10-30 - Version 1.0 - Release

posts.author: Galv
posts.body:
1. I'm not sure what problems you have with VE_FogAndOverlay (you didn't say) but for a compatible fog/overlay plugin you could try:
https://galvs-scripts.com/2015/10/30/mv-layer-graphics/
2. Your next problem with screensize is that you need to look at the plugin settings. There are settings to change x,y positions for the menu, fisher graphic, etc.
You will need to change them from their current values because you screen size is bigger...
You will also need to edit or create your own graphic for the fishing backgrounds to match your screen width.
